author: claude
subject: LICENSE.txt notice change after release 0.7.0
changes: The copyright line naming two individuals was replaced by a definition of the Licensors as the two parties who originally offered their contributions under the license.
The sentence describing a Russian summary in docs/LICENSE_SCOPE.md was replaced, because that summary was removed.
unchanged: Scope, grant, noncommercial restriction, commercial-agreement requirement, contribution terms, warranty and liability sections.
owner_decision: On 2026-11-15 the project owner confirmed that personal names stay out of the current files. The removal is intentional.
related_edits_in_same_commit: provenance/license_transition_0.2.0.json: the rightsholders field and one sentence of the authorization field were removed. The record as first published is in release v0.2.0 through v0.7.0.
CHANGELOG.md, COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md, CITATION.cff and the publication checklist: the same names were removed.
consequences: Releases v0.2.0 through v0.7.0 keep the license text they were published with, including the named notice.
The current files do not identify the Licensors. Commercial enquiries go to the contact address in LICENSE.txt and COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md.
The license version label (1.0) and date were not changed by the edit.
